Workwear as a service for the 
food and beverage industry

Hygiene you 
can wear
When it comes to food processing, every detail counts. 
That’s why we offer comfortable, practical workwear 
certified to DIN 10524 and designed for the food 
industry’s strict hygiene requirements.
We don’t design our collections around individual 
garments, but around the needs of the people who wear 
them. Each collection is tailored to different working 
environments, combining hygienic solutions, all-day 
comfort and practical features for everyday work.
Our passion for textiles goes back more than 100 years 
and shows in our professional laundry care and attention 
to detail – in every fibre and every seam.
| 3

The Food Clean collection is designed for food processing environments 
with strict hygiene requirements, with garments for HACCP risk classes 1–3.
The garments have no external pockets, significantly reducing the risk of 
contamination. This makes them suitable for handling perishable foods.

Smart: FLEX Comfort 
The smart choice for those on a budget: ideal for a stable 
workforce and normal working conditions. Cleaning, repairs 
and delivery included – a reliable and cost-effective option.
Customisable: FLEX Cozy
Greater flexibility for a dynamic workforce: free size exchanges 
included, with the option to remove up to 20% of wearers per 
year. This keeps your budget predictable while ensuring your 
entire workforce is fully equipped.
Complete peace of mind with FLEX Prime
Our premium solution for workwear subject to heavy use 
includes additional cover for premature wear, giving you 
maximum cost certainty – even in the most demanding 
workplaces.
CWS Workwear’s FLEX service gives you 
more than hygienic workwear. We take 
care of the professional cleaning, reliable 
repair and on-time delivery of your 
workwear and protective clothing, so 
you don't have to. Choose the contract 
model that best suits your business.
Workwear as 
a service
Workwear as a service
| 31

Workwear as a service
Image edited with AI
Your workwear is in good hands with us at each of our 33 modern 
industrial laundries. You can rely on our service driver to collect 
your worn workwear.
Each item then undergoes a standardised washing, 
inspection and finishing process tailored to the material. 
Following the final quality check, we return your workwear 
clean and on time – straight to your employees’ personal 
locker compartments, if you wish.
Simply put 
it on – we 
take care 
of the rest.
32 |

When you take off your work clothes, that’s when our work begins:
Your workwear will be hygienically cleaned in our certified laundries, 
checked by our specialist staff and, if necessary, repaired or replaced 
straight away.
We’ll collect your 
worn workwear 
from your 
premises.
We’ll deliver your 
workwear back to you, 
ready for use, and 
collect the next load 
of soiled laundry.
| 33

In person or online, we’re your trusted 
partner for workwear. With modern tools, 
we simplify processes, save time and 
deliver a service you’ll love.
34 |

Our Smart Lockers keep workwear available around the clock. 
Stock management is fully automated, with no manual effort 
required.
Stay in control with 
Smart Lockers
Find the right size in just a few clicks
Determine your staff’s clothing sizes online. Finding the right fit has 
never been easier. Avoid incorrect deliveries, reduce returns and 
ensure your staff are always comfortable – all in just a few clicks.
Submit repair requests through the app
Report damaged clothing using your smartphone. Simply scan the 
barcode on your garment and submit a repair request – it’s quick 
and flexible, with no need to make any further arrangements.
More than a logo – make your workwear part of 
your brand
Boost your company’s image with personalised workwear. We apply 
wash-resistant logos, names or job titles to your garments in line with 
your corporate identity guidelines. This ensures a consistent look and 
builds trust among your customers.
Personal and digital support for you
Whether you work 9 to 5 or 24/7, all your contract and service 
information is available at any time through our customer portal. 
You can also request changes and track their progress.
Full transparency with RFID technology 
Smart RFID technology allows you to keep track of your workwear 
stock. It flags shortages and surpluses, making your inventory 
management more efficient and more secure.
Your workwear, delivered straight to your locker
With our locker service, your employees receive freshly laundered 
workwear delivered directly to their personal locker compartments. 
Hygienic, secure and well organised.
| 35

Small footprint, 
green heart
We are reimagining workwear for the 
world we want to leave behind for our 
children and grandchildren. Sustainable 
materials, resource-efficient garment 
care and durable clothing create a cycle 
that protects both the environment and 
people – today and in the future.
36 |

Responsible supply 
chains
Our collections are designed in Germany and manufactured in 
Europe – which means short supply chains and a strong European 
supply base. 
All our suppliers meet ESG criteria and, by signing the CWS 
Workwear Code of Conduct, commit to strict social and 
environmental standards. We ensure that these values 
are put into practice through regular amfori BSCI audits.
Quality made in Europe: we are passionate about sustainability 
and local sourcing.
-70%
Our workwear enables you to reduce the 
harmful environmental impact typically 
associated with the use of workwear by 
70 per cent.
68%
Of our raw materials are sustainable – 
they are either recyclable or made from 
renewable resources.
| 37

Let’s make your business more sustainable – together. The textile 
industry is one of the biggest contributors to global greenhouse gas 
emissions. We’ve always worked differently: long before anyone 
coined the term “circular economy”, we were developing eco-friendly 
reusable solutions – and building sustainability into everything we do, 
day in, day out.
Because we don’t just take care of workwear. 
We take responsibility.

safety
